name: v8-press
framing: Fill 16:9 with no bars: baked-in bars are cut first, then each shot is cropped around its focus point, with the action kept near the horizontal centre because a phone shows only the middle quarter of the frame.
grading: One film stock: monochrome at 24 fps; flicker and native grain calmed; every shot brought to the same detail ceiling; each shot's measured 1st/99th percentiles mapped to one black/white, and its median pulled toward one target by a clamped gamma so low-key shots keep their blacks; one grain layer and vignette over the finished cut. Levels are measured per shot, never per frame, so exposure does not pump. Final darkness comes from the page's scrim.
